objective: Verify that Range variants are visually stable, domain-neutral, and usable in horizontal and vertical modes.
preconditions: Range filter supports variant presets or equivalent controls.
Range inputs, values, ticks, track style, handle shape, and icon overlay can be configured.
A test page contains narrow and wide Range instances.
steps: Test horizontal min-max with inputs visible.
Test horizontal compact with inputs hidden.
Test vertical with ticks visible and labels hidden.
Test vertical with inputs visible at narrow width.
Test icon handle enabled with small and large icon sizes.
Test neutral numeric labels, not price-specific labels.
expected_result: Range reads as a polished numeric filter, not a price-only component, and it does not overflow.
pass_criteria: icon handle remains inside the handle visual bounds.
vertical labels/ticks do not become incoherent.
hidden inputs do not reserve visible layout space.
